* Completion of an internship, graduate program, rotational program, academic project, or early\-career work experience in IT, systems analysis, business analysis, data analytics, application support, or technology project support.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to understand business processes and system functionality.

Veterinary Data Scientist
 
  




 PLANET.TECH — Austin, TX (Remote\-Flexible)
 
  




 About PLANET.TECH
 
 PLANET.TECH is a deep\-tech climate hardware company building technology that solves planetary\-scale problems — usually where no one's looking. We're developing the first continuous, non\-invasive biometric monitoring platform for cattle, enabling real\-time detection of acute physiological distress hours before visual symptoms appear. Our sensor platform collects multi\-modal physiological data at the individual\-animal level — something that has never been done at scale in livestock.
 



 We're a small, high\-velocity founding team backed by investors and working with university research partners. We have a robust patent portfolio, field\-validated hardware, and a deployment pipeline spanning tens of thousands of head. This is a ground\-floor opportunity to build the data science foundation of a platform that will define how the industry understands animal health.
 



  




 The Role
 
 We're looking for a research\-minded veterinarian with strong data instincts — someone who can bridge the gap between clinical veterinary knowledge and the data science needed to build and validate disease\-detection algorithms from physiological sensor data.
 



 You'll be the person who turns raw biometric signals into clinically meaningful health insights. You'll work at the intersection of veterinary medicine, time\-series data analysis, and machine learning — mining the literature, designing labeling protocols, building ground\-truth datasets, and collaborating directly with our engineering team to develop detection models.
 



  





 This is not a clinical role. It's a data role that requires deep veterinary knowledge to do correctly.
 



  




 What You'll Own
 * Design and lead the data labeling pipeline: define clinical event categories, build labeling protocols, train and manage contract labelers
* Review sensor data against clinical outcomes to build ground\-truth datasets for disease detection model training
* Collaborate with ML engineers on feature engineering, model evaluation, and clinical validation of detection algorithms
* Mine veterinary literature and epidemiological research to inform algorithm design and detection thresholds
* Support field validation studies: define study protocols (ARRIVE 2\.0 / STARD compliant), analyze results, contribute to peer\-reviewed publications
* Serve as the veterinary subject\-matter expert across the data pipeline — ensuring that what the models detect is clinically real and defensible



  




 Who You Are
 
**Must\-haves:** 



* DVM, VMD, or equivalent veterinary degree (or PhD in veterinary epidemiology, animal science, or a closely related field)
* Large\-animal clinical experience or research focus (beef and/or dairy cattle strongly preferred)
* Demonstrated comfort with data: you've worked with datasets, statistical analysis, or computational tools beyond what's typical in clinical practice
* Familiarity with or strong interest in machine learning concepts, particularly time\-series classification, signal processing, or biomedical data analysis
* Published or peer\-reviewed research experience (doesn't have to be in data science — we're looking for the research mindset)
* Ability to work across disciplines: you can explain clinical nuance to engineers and translate model outputs back into veterinary relevance



  





**Strong pluses:** 



* Experience with wearable sensor data, precision livestock farming (PLF), or veterinary informatics
* Python, R, or SQL proficiency
* Experience with study design for diagnostic accuracy (sensitivity/specificity, ROC analysis)
* Familiarity with bovine respiratory disease (BRD), parasitic conditions, or acute disease presentations in cattle
* Experience labeling or annotating biomedical data for ML training
* Connections in the bovine veterinary research community



  




 Compensation \& Structure
 
 This is an early\-stage founding team role. Compensation is structured accordingly:
 


* **Initial phase:** 
 Contract / part\-time (\~20\-35 hrs/week), compensation depending on experience and availability
* **Full\-time conversion:** 
 As the company scales, conversion to full\-time W\-2 with competitive salary
* **Equity:** 
 Meaningful early\-stage\-team equity grant. This is a ground\-floor position — your equity reflects that.
* **Location:** 
 Austin, TX preferred; remote\-flexible for the right candidate. Periodic travel to field sites required.



  




 Why This Role Matters
 
 Every detection algorithm we build is only as good as the veterinary expertise behind it. You're not supporting the data team — you ARE the bridge between raw physiology and clinical truth. The models we ship will be used by veterinarians and producers to make life\-or\-death decisions about individual animals. Getting that right requires someone who thinks like a researcher, speaks vet, and isn't afraid of a dataset.
 



  





 If you've ever felt like veterinary medicine needs better data infrastructure — this is your chance to build it from scratch.
 



  




 How to Apply
 
  





 Email griffin@planet.tech with:
 


1. Resume or CV highlighting research experience \+ any data/computational work
2. A short note (2–3 paragraphs) answering: "What's the hardest diagnostic problem in cattle health, and how would you approach it with continuous physiological data?"
3. Your availability and earliest start date



 We review applications on a rolling basis. This posting will remain open until filled.

 · Strong experience triaging SCA/SAST/DAST findings and managing high\-severity escalations (threat intel and critical patch events) through remediation and closure.
 



 · Engineering experience with scripting, automation, APIs, CI/CD workflows, developer tooling, or security platform integrations.
 



 · Practical familiarity with AI\-enabled security tools, frontier models, coding assistants, prompt and tool orchestration, model evaluation, or AI governance processes.
 



 · Experience securing the software supply chain and developer tooling (IDEs, plugins/extensions, package managers, CI/CD integrations) against compromise and malicious code.
 



 · Ability to translate technical vulnerability findings into clear remediation guidance, risk summaries, and prioritization recommendations for development and security stakeholders.

* Apply post\-training techniques (e.g. RLHF, reward modeling, policy optimization) to optimize guardrail model performance, calibration, and robustness against adaptive adversaries.

***About The Role***




 Want to be at the frontier of how the products of tomorrow get built? We're hiring an Agentic Engineer who builds by directing AI coding agents, and owns the outcome.
 



  





 Straddle is building the rails for the next era of payments, with the goal of moving money as fast as data moves. You'll help build that platform a level up from traditional coding: turning ambiguous problems into precise specs, breaking them into agent\-sized tasks, running several coding agents in parallel, and reviewing what they ship with a high bar. You'll write code by hand when that's the faster path, and delegate the rest. Because this is the infrastructure money runs on, security and correctness are never optional, and the bar you hold on agent output is what keeps it that way. You'll also help shape how Straddle builds with agents: the standards and tooling the rest of engineering will run on.
 



  





***Key Responsibilities:***



* **Spec before you build.** 
 Turn product and technical intent into precise specs agents can execute: clear interfaces, scope, and acceptance criteria. This is the highest\-leverage part of the job.
* **Decompose for agents.** 
 Break features, migrations, and bugs into agent\-sized tasks. Knowing what's too big for one pass, and how to slice it, is the craft.
* **Direct and orchestrate.** 
 Run multiple agents in parallel across features, integrations, and backlog. Keep them unblocked, correct course early, reset when a session drifts.
* **Own verification.** 
 Build the tests, builds, and checks that let agents self\-correct. On payment and compliance paths, if you can't verify it, it doesn't ship.
* **Review at volume.** 
 Read agent diffs critically for correctness, security, performance, and fit. You own the merge, the deploy, and the consequences.
* **Improve the system.** 
 Maintain the shared context agents rely on (project memory, skills, hooks, integrations, CI) so everyone's agents get better. Treat specs and agent config as version\-controlled engineering.
* **Security and compliance.** 
 Apply security best practices to agent\-generated code: authn/authz, encryption, common\-vulnerability defense, and fintech controls (PCI, SOC 2\).
* **Set the standard.** 
 Establish conventions and coach the team on specification, verification, and reviewing code they didn't write by hand.



  





***Required Qualifications:***



* **Strong engineering fundamentals.** 
 5\+ years building production software in a modern language, with the judgment to tell solid design from fragile design. That judgment is what makes directing and reviewing agents effective.
* **Hands\-on agentic experience.** 
 You've shipped real work with tools like Claude Code or Cursor agent mode, well beyond autocomplete.
* **Specification and decomposition.** 
 You break down hard problems and write them down precisely.
* **Verification mindset.** 
 Fluent in testing strategy and making correctness machine\-checkable, with sharp debugging and root\-cause skills.
* **High\-rigor review.** 
 You review fast and well, including code you didn't author, without dropping the bar.
* **At home with non\-determinism.** 
 You evaluate output quality instead of assuming it.
* **Communication and teamwork.** 
 Strong writer, collaborates well with product, design, and data science.



  





***Preferred Qualifications:***



* **Computer science foundations.** 
 A real understanding of CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, complexity). No specific degree required.
* **Fintech or payments.** 
 Payment processing, banking software, ledgers, ACH, or software compliance.
* **Agent tooling or evals.** 
 You've built internal tooling, eval harnesses, prompts, skills, or CI that made a team better with AI.
* **Our stack.** 
 Less important than your judgment, as long as you're comfortable reviewing it as agent output: .NET (C\#), TypeScript, and PostgreSQL, with solid architecture instincts (CQRS, Clean Architecture, DDD, SOLID).
* **Cloud.** 
 AWS, GCP, or Azure, architected for scale and reliability.
* **Leadership.** 
 You've led projects or helped a team adopt a new way of working.

* You will work at the cutting edge of AI, building agents that solve physical\-world engineering challenges rather than just digital tasks.
* The role offers direct influence over the engineering culture, technical architecture, and long\-term product roadmap of the company.


**What You Will Do**
* Design and implement intelligent context management and novel indexing approaches for hardware engineering agents.
* Build and post\-train ML models capable of reasoning over complex geometric and engineering design data.
* Collaborate directly with enterprise customers to ensure AI\-powered workflows are reliable and trusted in production.


**The ideal candidate**
* Holds a degree in Computer Science or Machine Learning with strong proficiency in LLM architectures and agent research.
* Proven track record of building and shipping production\-grade ML systems using PyTorch or Hugging Face.
* Exceptional programming skills with practical experience in search, information retrieval, or geometric data processing.


**Who are Jack \& Jill?**
 Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.
   

  

 And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.
   

  

**How does this work?**
* Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
* Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
* If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


**We never post fake jobs**
 This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.
   

  

 Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.
   

  

 We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.
   

  

 Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

**Job Description**
**Job Title:** 
 AI Engineer
   

  

**Job Type:** 
 Contract
   

  

**Location:** 
 Remote
   

  

**Job Summary:** 
 In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next\-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high\-quality, real\-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and optimize robust machine learning models for production environments.
* Implement and automate end\-to\-end ML pipelines using CI/CD best practices.
* Leverage AWS services for scalable AI infrastructure and model deployment.
* Orchestrate containerized workloads using Kubernetes to ensure high availability and seamless scalability.
* Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and researchers to translate complex business problems into actionable ML solutions.
* Evaluate, preprocess, and frame real\-world data problems for effective machine learning applications.
* Document and communicate findings, solution approaches, and technical decisions with clarity and precision.


**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* Proven expertise in machine learning algorithms, model development, and deployment.
* Strong programming skills, ideally in Python or Java, with experience in large\-scale software engineering projects.
* In\-depth experience with CI/CD workflows and automation tools.
* Hands\-on expertise with AWS cloud services for ML applications and data pipelines.
* Advanced knowledge of Kubernetes for orchestrating containerized ML workloads.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on clear technical documentation and team collaboration.
* Demonstrated ability to scope, structure, and solve complex, real\-world data challenges.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
* Experience working in high\-growth or startup environments.
* Strong publication record or contributions to open\-source AI projects.
